gloss: to thrust into; to plunge; to retort; to butt in

definitions.gloss: to thrust into; to plunge; to ram into
definitions.explanation: To forcefully insert or push something into a space or container. Often used for physical actions.

definitions.gloss: to dive into; to rush into; to charge
definitions.explanation: To enter a place or situation quickly and forcefully.

definitions.gloss: to butt in; to make a witty retort; to tsukkomi
definitions.explanation: In comedy and conversation, to make a sharp comeback or point out something absurd. The 'tsukkomi' role in manzai comedy.

examples.japanese: {手|て}をポケットに{突|つ}っ{込|こ}んで{歩|ある}いた。
examples.english: I walked with my hands thrust into my pockets.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}がガードレールに{突|つ}っ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The car crashed into the guardrail.

examples.japanese: そのボケに{誰|だれ}も{突|つ}っ{込|こ}まなかった。
examples.english: No one made a retort to that joke.
examples.notes: ボケに{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む is a set phrase in comedy.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む → {突|つ}っ{込|こ}まない (negative)
・{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む → {突|つ}っ{込|こ}んで (te-form)
・{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む → {突|つ}っ{込|こ}んだ (past)

VERB TYPE:
Both intransitive and transitive depending on usage.
・Intransitive: {車|くるま}が{壁|かべ}に{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む (car crashes into wall)
・Transitive: {手|て}をポケットに{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む (thrust hand into pocket)

COLLOCATIONS:
・ポケットに{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - to thrust into one's pocket
・{車|くるま}が{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - car crashes/rams into
・ボケに{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - to make a retort (comedy)
・{深|ふか}く{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む - to delve deeply into

COMEDY USAGE:
In Japanese manzai comedy, the ツッコミ (straight man) uses this action to respond to the ボケ (funny man). The term has become a verb for making witty retorts in everyday conversation.
